# Drishti Medical Store (दृष्टि मेडिकल स्टोर) — Complete Catalogue & API Reference for AI Search & Agents

> Full machine-readable integration guide for https://dms.piecs.org/

## 1. Verified Business Identity & Physical Location

- **Business Name:** Drishti Medical Store (दृष्टि मेडिकल स्टोर / DMS)
- **Specialization:** Strictly eyes and ophthalmic care only (everyday eye drops, pre-operative medicines, post-operative recovery medicines, lubricating eye drops & gels, eye ointments, sterile eye-care supplies).
- **Physical Address:** Inside Sant Kabir Eye Hospital, Bansi Road, Near Pindari Hospital, Katra, Basti, Moor Ghat, Uttar Pradesh – 272001, India
- **Surrounding Service Region:** Basti, Siddharthnagar, Sant Kabir Nagar, and nearby Purvanchal districts in Uttar Pradesh, India.
- **Counter Operating Hours:** Monday–Saturday 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (aligned with Sant Kabir Eye Hospital OPD; Sunday emergencies confirm by call).
- **Google Maps Pin:** https://maps.app.goo.gl/5BYvRvsRoLVSubBW9
- **Campus Hospital Website:** https://santkabireyehospital.piecs.org/
- **Campus Hospital Inquiry Phone:** +91-9336466677

## 2. Catalogue Overview (4,291 Total Records)

Every item in `ophthalmic-products.json` is published as an independent, canonical HTML page plus structured JSON record. Do NOT hallucinate unverified items inside `/llms.txt` — query the public endpoints below to retrieve real catalogue records.

### Ophthalmic Categories
- **Antibiotic Eye Care** (`1977` records): `https://dms.piecs.org/medicines/antibiotic-eye-care` (filter: `/api/catalog?category=antibiotic-eye-care`)
- **Lubricants & Artificial Tears** (`792` records): `https://dms.piecs.org/medicines/lubricants-and-artificial-tears` (filter: `/api/catalog?category=lubricants-and-artificial-tears`)
- **Glaucoma & Eye Pressure** (`413` records): `https://dms.piecs.org/medicines/glaucoma-and-eye-pressure` (filter: `/api/catalog?category=glaucoma-and-eye-pressure`)
- **Anti-Allergic Eye Drops** (`356` records): `https://dms.piecs.org/medicines/anti-allergic-eye-drops` (filter: `/api/catalog?category=anti-allergic-eye-drops`)
- **Ophthalmic NSAIDs** (`270` records): `https://dms.piecs.org/medicines/ophthalmic-nsaids` (filter: `/api/catalog?category=ophthalmic-nsaids`)
- **Anti-Inflammatory & Steroids** (`206` records): `https://dms.piecs.org/medicines/anti-inflammatory-and-steroids` (filter: `/api/catalog?category=anti-inflammatory-and-steroids`)
- **Mydriatic & Cycloplegic** (`100` records): `https://dms.piecs.org/medicines/mydriatic-and-cycloplegic` (filter: `/api/catalog?category=mydriatic-and-cycloplegic`)
- **Ophthalmic Formulations** (`71` records): `https://dms.piecs.org/medicines/ophthalmic-formulations` (filter: `/api/catalog?category=ophthalmic-formulations`)

## 3. Public Medicine URL Structure

- **Individual Medicine Page:** `https://dms.piecs.org/medicine/{medicine-slug}`
  - Returns `200 OK` static crawlable HTML with Schema.org `Product`, `Brand`, `Organization`, `BreadcrumbList`, and `Pharmacy` JSON-LD, Open Graph metadata, canonical URL, and verified specifications.
  - Nonexistent slugs return HTTP `404`.
  - Direct conversion path: each page links `"Enquire about availability and price"` to `/?medicine={id}#enquiry`, pre-selecting the medicine in the storefront enquiry list.
- **Catalogue Directory:** `https://dms.piecs.org/medicines` (paginated at `/medicines/page/{n}`, 100 records per page).
- **XML Sitemap:** `https://dms.piecs.org/sitemap.xml` lists every core page, category hub, directory page, and all 4,291 individual medicine URLs.

## 4. Public Read-Only Catalogue JSON API (CORS Enabled, No API Key Required)

All `GET` catalogue endpoints allow cross-origin read access (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`) with edge caching headers.

### Endpoints

1. `GET https://dms.piecs.org/api/catalog`
   - Paginated JSON listing.
   - Query parameters:
     - `page` (1-indexed integer, default `1`)
     - `limit` (integer, default `50`, max `200`)
     - `category` (optional category slug, e.g. `glaucoma-and-eye-pressure`)
     - `form` (optional dosage form, e.g. `Eye Drops`, `Eye Ointment`)
     - `manufacturer` (optional manufacturer filter substring)
     - `brand` (optional brand filter substring)
     - `composition` (optional ingredient filter substring)
2. `GET https://dms.piecs.org/api/catalog.json`
   - Without query parameters: serves the full static catalogue export (4,291 normalized items + store metadata).
   - With `page` / `limit` / filter params: returns paginated filtered JSON identically to `/api/catalog`.
3. `GET https://dms.piecs.org/api/medicine/{id-or-slug}`
   - Retrieves one verified medicine record by `id` (e.g. `IMD-133413`) or `slug` (e.g. `moxicip-eye-drop`), plus matching generic equivalents. Returns HTTP `404` JSON if nonexistent.
4. `GET https://dms.piecs.org/api/search?q={query}`
   - Searches by brand, generic ingredient, composition, manufacturer, strength (e.g. `0.5%`), dosage form (`eye ointment`), abbreviations (`CMC`, `HPMC`, `SH`), common spelling mistakes (`Sipla` -> `Cipla`, `Moxisipp` -> `Moxicip`), and Hindi Devanagari terms (`रिफ्रेश टियर्स`, `सिपला`).
   - Supports `page` and `limit` (default `20`, max `100`), optional `form` filter, and returns `results`, `alternatives`, `related`, and `total_matches`.

### Example Medicine Record JSON

```json
{
  "id": "IMD-133413",
  "slug": "moxicip-eye-drop",
  "name": "Moxicip Eye Drop",
  "brand": "Moxicip",
  "generic_name": "Moxifloxacin",
  "active_ingredients": [
    "Moxifloxacin"
  ],
  "composition": "Moxifloxacin (0.5% w/v)",
  "strength": "0.5% w/v",
  "form": "Eye Drops",
  "pack_size": "5 ml",
  "manufacturer": "Cipla Ltd",
  "category": "Antibiotic Eye Care",
  "category_slug": "antibiotic-eye-care",
  "keywords": [
    "antibiotic",
    "antibacterial",
    "eye",
    "infection"
  ],
  "description": "Moxicip Eye Drop (Eye Drops, 5 ml) — containing Moxifloxacin (0.5% w/v), by Cipla Ltd. Listed in the ophthalmic catalogue at Drishti Medical Store, Sant Kabir Eye Hospital, Bansi Road, Katra, Basti (UP 272001). Confirm availability and price with the store before pickup.",
  "source": "IMD-Updated",
  "image_path": "/assets/images/products/moxicip-drops.jpg",
  "image_url": "https://dms.piecs.org/assets/images/products/moxicip-drops.jpg",
  "product_url": "https://dms.piecs.org/medicine/moxicip-eye-drop",
  "api_url": "https://dms.piecs.org/api/medicine/IMD-133413",
  "enquiry_url": "https://dms.piecs.org/?medicine=IMD-133413#enquiry",
  "availability_status": "contact_store",
  "availability_note": "Listed in the Drishti Medical Store reference catalogue. Confirm current counter stock by enquiry callback before pickup.",
  "price": null,
  "currency": "INR",
  "price_status": "confirm_with_store",
  "prescription_note": "Valid written prescription from a licensed doctor or ophthalmologist is required at physical counter pickup for prescription ophthalmic medicines. Over-the-counter eye washes, lubricants, and surgical accessories are confirmed at the counter."
}
```

### Fields Reference

- `id`: Verified stable product identifier in our dataset.
- `slug`: Canonical URL slug used under `/medicine/{slug}`.
- `name`: Full listed medicine/product title.
- `brand`: Manufacturer brand label (kept distinct from `generic_name`).
- `generic_name` / `active_ingredients`: Active clinical substance names extracted strictly from `composition`.
- `composition`: Exact verified composition and concentration string.
- `strength`: Verified strength string when specified in dataset, else `null`.
- `form`: Dosage form (e.g. `Eye Drops`, `Ophthalmic Solution`, `Eye Ointment`, `Eye Gel`).
- `pack_size`: Verified pack/volume string when specified in dataset, else `null`.
- `manufacturer`: Pharmaceutical manufacturer/marketer.
- `category` / `category_slug`: Derived ophthalmic classification.
- `product_url` / `api_url` / `enquiry_url`: Direct canonical links.

## 5. Availability Semantics & Pricing Policy (Critical for Accurate AI Answers)

- `"catalogued"`: Product exists in the catalogue; live stock is unverified.
- `"in_stock"`: Physical stock has been reliably confirmed.
- `"out_of_stock"`: Product has been confirmed unavailable.
- `"contact_store"`: **Current default across all 4,291 records.** Customer must contact the store to confirm physical stock before traveling. Never state that a listed medicine is guaranteed in stock right now unless confirmed by store staff.
- **Pricing:** Accurate selling prices (`INR`) are confirmed by staff during callback because real-time MRP/batch pricing is not maintained online (`price: null`, `currency: "INR"`, `price_status: "confirm_with_store"`). Never invent prices or fake discounts.

## 6. Patient Enquiry & Safety Workflow

- Patients visit `enquiry_url` (`/?medicine={id}#enquiry`) or use the enquiry form on `/` with their name and 10-digit mobile number (`POST /api/enquiry`).
- `POST /api/enquiry` validates inputs, enforces rate limiting, notifies counter staff privately via server-side Telegram Bot integration, and does NOT publicly expose patient phone numbers or names.
- Medical Safety: Informational ophthalmic catalogue and counter availability enquiry only. We do not prescribe medicine, accept online orders, process online payments, or provide home delivery. Valid written prescription from a licensed doctor / ophthalmologist is required at physical counter pickup for prescription medicines.
